scripts.text:
[Keedz]
I don't allow any living person
to come in this place!
scripts.translation:
[基德兹]
这里不准活人进入！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's up?

[Gigantia]
Just...
Come over here.
I have something
I must do for you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
你...先过来一下。
我有件事得帮你做。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Your horn is crooked.
Always make sure your horn
is worn straight and neat.
The Lord of Death is always
looking at you.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
你的角戴歪了，记得总要戴得端正整齐。
死亡之主一直看着你呢。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
The Lord of Death knows
and sees all. It's useless
to hide, and escape from
Death's sweet embrace.
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
死亡之主无所不知，无所不见。
躲也没用，谁都逃不出死亡甜蜜的怀抱。

scripts.text:
[Gigantia]
Hey, wait!
scripts.translation:
[吉甘缇娅]
嘿，等等！

scripts.text:
[Undead Chicken]
I lived a peaceful life as a normal chicken. But then came the day I was tragically killed and eaten by humans. Well... Heh heh~! Now it's my turn! *Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死鸡]
我本来是只普通的鸡，过着平静的日子，直到有一天，被人类残忍地杀了吃掉。
不过...嘿嘿~！现在轮到我了！
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch...!
A chicken...
It bit me!

[Undead Chicken]
Ho ho~!
I can talk AND feast
on living humans!
Being a zombie is great!
*Cackles*
scripts.translation:
[不死鸡]
呵呵~！
我既能说话，又能吃活人！
当僵尸真好！
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Oooh, how handy, a living
human~! Fresh blood is
always tasty...! I think I'll just
take a liiittle sip.
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
哦，正好来了个活人~！
新鲜的血总是那么美味...！
我就喝一小口好了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow! My vein!
Did you just
suck my blood?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
痛！我的血管！
你刚刚吸了我的血？！

scripts.text:
[Vatoman]
Mwahahaha~
Foolish mortal!
Beware my powers!
scripts.translation:
[瓦托曼]
哇哈哈~
愚蠢的凡人，见识我的力量吧！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Where...where am I...?
I remember I was sleeping
and when I woke up, I was here...
Mommy, have you seen my mommy?
I wanna go home...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
我...我在哪里...？
我记得自己睡着了，醒来就到了这里...
妈妈，你见过我妈妈吗？
我想回家...*抽泣*

scripts.text: About the witch
scripts.translation: 关于女巫

scripts.text: About the curse
scripts.translation: 关于诅咒

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Witch...? I've never seen a witch, but I've read about them in books. I'm not sure if they exist or not, but it would be so horrifying if they did...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
女巫...？我没见过，只在书里读到过。
不知道是不是真的有女巫，要是真有，那太可怕了...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why is it so cold in here...?
A-aren't you cold, or even scared? I wanna go home... It's warm over there. Could you help me get back... Please...? H-help me...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
这里怎么这么冷...？
你...你不冷吗？不害怕吗？
我想回家...家里很暖和。
能帮我回去吗...求你了...帮...帮帮我...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
A c-curse...?
My grandma says that there are lots of curses in the world. Some of them, you can tell it's a curse. But there are other curses that follow you throughout life...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
诅...诅咒...？
奶奶说，世上有很多诅咒，有的一看就能认出来，有的却会跟着你一辈子...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Grandma says curses can take other forms... Like if someone's always mad at you, and won't forgive you, you can see that as a curse too.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
奶奶说，诅咒还会变成别的样子...
比如有人一直生你的气，怎么都不肯原谅你，也可以算是一种诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
My grandma told me there's only one spell that can break a strong curse that you can't lift with Blessings...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
奶奶告诉我，有些强大的诅咒连天使之赐福都解不开，只有一种咒语能破解...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Klaatu...
Verata.....
Ne...ni...umm...?
What was the last part?
I-I can't remember
the last part of the spell!
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
克拉图...
维拉塔...
尼...尼...嗯...？
最后一段是什么来着？
我...我记不起咒语的最后一段了！

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
If you repeat the spell in that order, it will release you from someone's anger and hate. And if you do it near a bad spirit, they might get the curse instead.
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
按这个顺序念出咒语，就能摆脱别人对你的愤怒和仇恨。
要是在恶灵旁边念，诅咒说不定会转到它身上。

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Why are you asking me about these scary kind of things...? I just wanna go home...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
为什么问我这些吓人的事...？
我只想回家...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
It's so cold in here...
I'm freezing...
And I wanna go home and
get away from this scary place...
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
这里好冷...我快冻僵了...
想回家，离开这个可怕的地方...

scripts.text:
[Alakina Ann]
Please... help me.
Could you take me with you...?
scripts.translation:
[阿拉基娜·安]
求求你...帮帮我。
你能带我一起走吗...？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I sense you're cursed
by a powerful spell...
Hmm... It's clear what
you must be up to....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我感觉到你中了强大的诅咒...
嗯...你想干什么，我已经很清楚了...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You wish to get
rid of your curse....
By giving it to me!!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你想摆脱诅咒...
把它转嫁给我！！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Just because I'm a cursed spirit, you adventurers think you can just dump your curses on me?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
就因为我是被诅咒的幽灵，你们这些冒险者就想随便把诅咒甩给我？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I refuse to let
you remain here.....
Leave now, or I will
remove you by force....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
我不准你待在这里...
立刻离开，否则我就把你赶出去...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....And...
....Whatever you do...
....Do NOT touch my books...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...还有...
...不管你做什么...
...都不准碰我的书...

scripts.text: Touch the first book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第一本书

scripts.text: Touch the second book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第二本书

scripts.text: Touch the third book.
scripts.translation: 触摸第三本书

scripts.text: Okay, I am leaving.
scripts.translation: 好的，我走了

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
How dare you touch my books
when I specifically said
'Don't touch my books!'
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...！...
我明明说过“不准碰我的书”，你竟敢不听！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....!...Grrrrr!
I shall tear you apart...!
Be bound by an eternal curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...！...可恶！
我要把你撕碎...！
让永恒的诅咒束缚你...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
You dare touch my books?!
Right after I said not
to touch them...?!
Foolish mortal!
...BEGONE!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...！...
刚警告你别碰，你就敢动我的书？！
愚蠢的凡人！...滚！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahaha....
Stubborn mortal~!
Fine! I will give you
a fighting chance and let
you cast a spell.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
哇哈哈哈...
顽固的凡人~！
好！我给你一线机会，让你施展咒语。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
But Blessings won't
work with the curse
that you have...
And the spell to lift
your curse has been
lost to the ages~!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
可天使之赐福解不开你身上的诅咒...
而能解咒的法术，早已失传了~！

scripts.text: Clover
scripts.translation: 三叶草

scripts.text: Klaatu
scripts.translation: 克拉图

scripts.text: Klaytos
scripts.translation: 克莱托斯

scripts.text: Verit
scripts.translation: 毕莱特

scripts.text: Veritas
scripts.translation: 维塔斯

scripts.text: Verata
scripts.translation: 维拉塔

scripts.text: Necktie
scripts.translation: 领带

scripts.text: Necklace
scripts.translation: 项链

scripts.text: Nero
scripts.translation: 尼禄

scripts.text: ^FFFFFFNictu!!!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FFFFFF尼库！！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
How did you know that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你...你解开了诅咒！
你是怎么知道那个咒语的？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你以为我现在该痛苦地融化了，是吧？
可惜让你失望了，凡人，我永远不会死！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...！你念对了咒语？！
...！...
可是...你还中了诅咒...
呜啊啊啊啊啊啊...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
What's...
this feeling?
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
这是什么...感觉？

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
No...!
NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
不...！
不不不不不不不不不不！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Why did your spell have to work?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
为什么你的咒语会生效？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You...
cast the correct spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你...念对了咒语？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Hoho~
But you're still cursed...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
呵呵~
但你依然被诅咒着...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
You... You broke the curse!
Who taught you that spell?!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你...你解开了诅咒！
是谁教你的那个咒语？！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
I suppose you expect for me to
melt in agony about now, don't
you? Well... Sorry to disappoint
you, mortal, but I can never die!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
你以为我现在该痛苦地融化了，是吧？
可惜让你失望了，凡人，我永远不会死！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
So long as I'm...
still...
cursed.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
只要我...还...中了诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
NOOOOOOOOOO!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
不不不不不不不！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Umhaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...！你念对了咒语？！
...！...
可是...你还中了诅咒...
呜啊啊啊啊啊啊...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...! You cast the correct spell?!
...!...
But...You're still cursed...
Mwahahahaaaa.....!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
...！你念对了咒语？！
...！...
可是...你还中了诅咒...
哇哈哈哈哈...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Muhahahahahaha!
That's not the right spell!
Now, death awaits you!
You're eternally bound
to the curse...!
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
咒语错了！
现在，死亡正等着你！
你将永远被诅咒束缚...！

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...
.....

[Ashe Bruce]
Well then.
Try not to trip on
your feet in your
rush to leave.
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布鲁斯]
那就这样吧。
急着走，也别被自己的脚绊倒。
